question: Test whether the unweighted boundary action supplies the Whitney shear-port equalizer.
assumptions: Regular Euclidean cell, unit edge-circulation Whitney one-forms and common face averaging.
Cooriented flag identification and closed skew port from v0.10.
Coefficient-one comparison uses the declared nondimensional unit side length.
fitted_choices: Literal unit coefficient is the requested test; c=1/48 is the comparison selected by equality. No empirical fit.

sources.section_or_object_id: Whitney curl Gram and centered rotational energy

baseline: Unaugmented and equalized v0.10 Whitney ports
result: The literal unit-cell curl energy supplies 16/3, 48 times the required 1/9. Squared rates are (4/3,106/9) and exact common half transfer is impossible for this port.
next_discriminant: Test whether native transport fixes a relative length-squared weight independently of spectral equalization, or use sector-resolved latches.
